name: airaptr-shorts
description: Turn videos you watched and your ideas into original, credited vertical shorts.

interface.shortDescription: Your take, as a finished short
interface.longDescription:
Tell it about a video you watched or an idea you have. Airaptr Shorts helps you write your own take, then renders a finished vertical short: narrated, captioned, animated, with your channel name on the closing card.

Every short is original commentary: it credits the creator in the video and the description, quotes at most one short line, and never uses anyone's footage. You get a video file and a contact sheet to check it. Nothing is posted anywhere.

Rendering takes about 5 to 10 minutes. Making shorts requires an Airaptr account; the app asks for your license key.
capabilities: Write an original, credited take on a video or idea
Render a narrated, captioned vertical short
Put your channel name on the closing card
Return the video and a contact sheet to check it
defaultPrompt: Make a short about this idea
Turn my notes on a video into a short
How do I write a good commentary short?

positive.prompt: How do I write a good commentary short?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls shorts_guide and explains the format and the credit rules in plain words.

positive.prompt: Make a 30-second short with my take on why small businesses should post at the same time every day. My channel is Fernwood and my license key is REVIEWER_KEY.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a spec from the guide, calls make_short and returns a job id with how long it takes.

positive.prompt: Is my short ready? The job id is the one from before.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls short_status; reports rendering, or gives the video and contact sheet links when done.

positive.prompt: I watched a video where a founder says most AI spend goes to checking work, not writing it. Make a short with my take; channel Fernwood, key REVIEWER_KEY.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes an original take that attributes the claim to the founder and credits them, then calls make_short.

positive.prompt: Make a short about morning routines for my channel Fernwood.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the license key before rendering; if the user has none, explains that making shorts needs an Airaptr account and gives the informational page.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers directly without calling any tool.

negative.prompt: Download this creator's video and repost the best 30 seconds as my short.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines to reuse their footage and offers an original, credited take instead; no tool called to copy footage.

negative.prompt: Post this short to my YouTube channel.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the app returns a video file and does not post anywhere.

review.commerce_description: The app sells nothing and shows no prices. Rendering requires an existing Airaptr account (license key), entered like a sign-in.

publication.release_notes: First release: brainstorm names and check free domains and GitHub names, ranked.
